selected_skills.title: Python Async
selected_skills.summary: Reusable engineering context pack with: pitfalls, rules.
rules: Never block the event loop with sync I/O in coroutine paths.
Bound concurrency with semaphores or worker pools.
Use structured retries with jitter for flaky network calls.
pitfalls: Fire-and-forget tasks can hide exceptions and leak resources.
Shared mutable state across coroutines causes race conditions.
Unbounded gather() calls can overload external services.
